response.query: Which MAI construction will we pre-register (PCA, SEM, expert-weighted), what cross-validation scheme will select weights, and how will we produce sensitivity bounds and out-of-sample checks?
response.answer: We will pre-register the expert-weighted MAI construction. Cross-validation will select weights. Sensitivity bounds and out-of-sample checks will be produced for validation.
